title: Bodycam: Mom Busted for Shoplifting from Walmart with Baby Stroller, Police Say
description:
Bodycam footage shows the aftermath of a Florida woman allegedly shoplifting from Walmart using a baby stroller on May 29. Madison Rowbotham was accompanied by her infant and a 14-year-old while she allegedly stashed merchandise into the empty stroller. Security caught on quick and detained her until police arrived. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

If you experienced adverse side effects after taking Ozempic or another weight loss medication, check your eligibility to file a claim by visiting: https://www.glp1case.com/lcbodycam?v=obc13

Rowbotham is accused of choosing to use her baby stroller for theft, rather than for her child. Walmart staff reported witnessing her putting clothes, accessories, and other items inside the stroller as she “shopped.” The Lake City woman is charged with retail theft and contributing to the delinquency of a child.
